integrity: Proof is analytic for every admissible real Jacobi parameter and every nonnegative integer radial degree; finite symbolic checks are diagnostic only. Source date follows the dated publicly released 2018 report, not the later arXiv posting.
scientific_limitations: Centered disk or ball single-mode cumulative energy only; the compared Zernike modes have the same radial index and different total degrees. No multi-mode compression eigenvalue, arbitrary aperture, or priority-certificate claim.
title: Exactly twice the radial degree: angular-step crossings of Zernike disk energy
